21.. COVID-19 UPDATE (CITY COUNCIL) Raymond Cheng gave a  COVID 19 Trends presentation. 
Robert Lennox noted that city park playgrounds are closed. Mayor Robles stated to keep the playgrounds closed until the ICU capacity ratings have declined with no objections. 

Robert Lennox spoke about the Drive Thru event and Santa Sleigh experience Tuesday and Wednesday, December 22nd and 23rd 6pm to 8pm  

LDH inquired about the route. Lennox noted the sleigh will travel east of Avalon on 22nd and west of Avalon on 23rd.  

LDH noted she will like the program expanded to cover the entire city. 

Mike Whittaker spoke about the challenges staff have with the Santa Sleigh program.
